name: CKEditor 5 Definition List Fix
description: CKEditor 5 plugin that stops unwanted paragraph wrappers inside definition-list terms.
project_description:
CKEditor 5 Definition List Fix is a lightweight, JavaScript-only CKEditor 5 plugin that preserves semantic HTML definition-list markup during editing. Drupal core's CKEditor 5 integration can normalize definition lists in unwanted ways: converting
elements into paragraphs, inserting stray

wrappers inside

/
, and altering otherwise-valid
structures. This module registers model elements and upcast/downcast converters for
,
and
so the structure survives a round-trip through the editor, keeping id/class/style attributes intact. It additionally preserves inline elements (e.g. et cetera) by preventing CKEditor from wrapping them in redundant , which matters for foreign phrases, taxonomic names and semantic voice. The module ships a toolbar button plus SVG icon that authors add to a text format's CKEditor 5 toolbar; there is no PHP, no routes, no permissions and no configuration screen of its own. It targets accessibility-focused, government, technical-documentation, glossary and FAQ content where correct definition-list semantics are required. Compatible with Drupal 10, 11 and 12, and requires only core CKEditor 5.
